Draft Grades & Week 1 Power Rankings

“Wait Lewie, isn't it cheating to assign draft grades after week 1 when you have a sample size of how some of those picks will shake out?” I was on vacation; what do you want from me? And besides, I don't need a week of data to tell you all how horrible your teams are going to be!

A-tier — league winners B-tier — solid, question marks C-tier — meh, could go either way D-tier — dumpster fire
01 A-

Bad Boys Bad Boys

Anders  /  1-0 · 143 PF

On the surface, this team looks stacked. Lamar Jackson. *next slide* Derrick Henry. *next slide* Sun God. *next slide* Any questions? Ok, reeling it in — RB may be an issue. I think Hall will be passable but inconsistent. If/when Jacobs comes back, RB2 will be set, but that's a big question mark. The receivers behind ARSB are unspectacular. I think Odunze is overrated. BTJ could be a good pull but that's a big tbd. Worthy blows — fuck the Chiefs. Concepcion and Strib-club are both good stashes for late season. The double TE terror set of Kincaid and Kittle is really intriguing. Kittle will probably be slow to start the year coming back from injury but he could be a nightmare late in the season. All in all, I like this squad, and with a trade or two, it could easily make a run.

02 B+

I'm Doing Something

Dan  /  1-0 · 141 PF

After years of consistently placing 3rd, Dan has been out of the race for the past few years. I think that changes this season. After successfully navigating home from North Korea to attend the draft, Dan kicked into gear and assembled a squad that could do some damage. Dak is gonna sling it and is consistently underrated in fantasy. Gibbs is a cheat code so we don't need to talk about him. RB2 is the biggest question mark here, but Dan hedged his bets, and I think one of Price, Lloyd, or Dowdle will make enough of an impact to be a consistent starter. His receivers are sneaky good — the fact that he can choose between Nico, Olave, McConkey, AND Evans is scary. All 4 of those have a rocky injury history, so that limits the fear a little bit, but man, that's a good receiver room. I think the biggest reason Dan is going to reclaim his rightful 3rd place in the standings is that he got his guy — Mark Andrews. Is he still a good TE? No. But Dan drafted him more times than I can count, so it just feels right.

03 B+

Second Dinner

Tyler  /  1-0 · 135 PF

I'm pretty warm on this team. Hurts is at the helm, and even though I don't think he's that good in real life, he's a damn good fantasy player. I want KW3 to fail hard because A) fuck the Chiefs and B) fuck KW3 for sealing Tyler's win over me in week 1. But he's a good get by Tyler and looks like he's gonna ball out this year. Throw in Monty, who had a monster 3-TD start to the year, Chuba, whose death may have been greatly exaggerated, and JCM, who reddit might have been a year too early on, and you have a pretty solid RB room. Chase and Pickens are beasts, and the options of Pittman and Meyers behind them aren't too shabby. All in all, I think Tyler done good. He might even get third dinner.

04 B

I Know Nothing About Football

Davide & James  /  0-1 · 113 PF

If you aren't drafting for upside, you aren't drafting — James, probably. This team features some of the most explosive players in the league: Achane, Barkley, Nabers, J-Mo, DK, and Henderson. If you could pair that with consistency, this team wouldn't lose a single game. I love the upside play, but let me bring this back to reality. Achane is the ONLY asset on the Dolphins and their opponents know it — expect him to get special attention from defenses. Nabers is going to get injured. J-Mo will be a top-20 WR because of five 25+ point performances, but guessing which games those will be is the hard part. Henderson sucks at pass protection so Vrabel doesn't trust him with the full-time role. DK has check-down king Rodgers throwing at him. It's not all doom and gloom — Flowers is a DUDE and I love Goedert and Barkley. I think this team has a ton of potential with very little stability. There's no floor and no ceiling… so maybe they're in the ocean?

05 B

The Metalloid Maniacs

Lew  /  0-1 · 120 PF

I drafted this team — it's a league winner. T-Law is gonna ball out and be a top-5 QB, James Cook, Javonte, and Swift will be absolute studs, and AJ Brown… fuck. Welp, there goes the season. I'm glad I scooped Parker Washington a little early because I'm hopeful he can hold me over while Brown recovers. But WR is gonna be an issue — there's a small chance Adams is washed and the same could be said for Godwin. IDK — nobody is reading this so I don't really want to talk about my team. I'm tired. Go away.

06 B-

Bijan Bo Rice

Ian  /  1-0 · 105 PF

Honestly, Bijan and Josh Allen alone might be enough to win most weeks. Ian took a strong handcuff approach to RB, drafting two backs each from ATL, TB, and DEN. I don't hate it. He scraped the bargain bin for his receiving corps, which could come back to bite him. Rashee Rice's ADP plummeted because he's a bad person and rehabbed from his offseason surgery in prison — the skill is still there though, so I think that'll pay dividends. I'm not as sure about Sutton or Deebo. I think they'll each have spike games (see Deebo week 1) but I wouldn't bank on consistency. Loveland is a nice piece, but Ian will need him to rebound from the goose egg he laid in week 1. I usually love the teams Ian drafts, but I'm not sold on this one.

07 B-

Dafano Clan

Kirsten  /  1-0 · 108 PF

I heckled the shit out of Kirsten for doing absolutely zero research before the draft. This team isn't stacked, but I may have been too harsh on her. I'm a Caleb Williams hater because he seems like a really weird guy… like I get the vibe he could secretly be a serial killer and be super nonchalant about it. But he's good at football. At RB, Chase Brown is a stud, ETN will find his footing in NO, and there's some decent depth with Mondre and Charbs when he comes back. I'm not too keen on the receivers here though. Puka is a supreme talent, but the vibes are bad — between running into a glass door, biting a woman, and taking every opportunity possible to practice new antisemitic rants, I'm not sure how much time Puka's had to practice. He'll still be good, but I wouldn't feel good rooting for him. Behind him, Kirst has Tee "the Glass Cannon" Higgins, Not-So-Scary Terry, and some guys who'll be on the waivers soon. This team will be okay, but I'd be surprised if it makes a deep playoff run.

08 C+

Beast Mode

Eric  /  1-0 · 105 PF

After fielding a powerhouse in 2024, Eric spent last season hanging out at the bottom of the standings, ripping parliaments and crushing 40oz shipyard pumpkinheads. With eyes on a comeback, Eric feverishly drafted what he proclaims is a "league winner for the ages" and tried his hardest to keep the average age of his players below 23.6 — I'm pretty sure he pre-drafted some high schoolers to make the numbers work. I'm not sold on this team. Let's start with the good: his WRs are great, JJettas, DJ Moore, and Tet are all dudes, and Burden has a lot of hype and tremendous upside. BUT there's a big problem at RB. Behind his workhorse Jeanty, Beast Mode has an inefficient RB on a bad team (Judkins) with Woody Marks as his only other back. That's no bueno — no bueno indeed. Dart is a fine fantasy QB, but he seems to be trying to catch Skat in the race of "who can get the worst CTE ever documented," which worries me. If Eric can flip a WR for some much-needed help at RB, he might be able to ditch the parliaments (he won't go cold turkey on the pumpkinhead — we've tried), but I don't see him climbing too high up the rankings.

09 C

Joe Burrow Comeback Player

Jeff  /  0-1 · 70 PF

This is another team I'm just kind of "meh" on. CMC and Kyren are good headliners to the RB room, but I expect both to regress a bit. Monangai is a solid piece behind them, but that's a shallow room. I really don't like the WR room here. London is an amazing talent trapped on a team with three terrible QBs. Waddle is Jeff's guy, but I worry DEN will have too many mouths to feed. MHJ is a bum and isn't even the WR1 on the Cardinals. At least Jeff will get 20-30 points from Christian Watson for seven games. I'm not seeing it here — I think this squad will struggle a bit and may see .500.

10 C

Moon Men

Jared  /  0-1 · 98 PF

Jared started the draft strong by selecting JT to lead the charge, then followed up with McBride in the 2nd round. Look, I'm not a tight end guy, but if you're into that — cool. Then his draft kind of fell off a cliff. Looking at his WRs, Egbuka could be that guy, but relying on a breakout from him AND for the Jets not to completely waste Garrett Wilson's career is a big ask. So Jared probably stocked up on some receiver depth to hedge against that risk, right? No — he zagged and decided he only needed two other receivers on his roster: an aging Diggs and an oft-injured Downs. His RB situation gets pretty shaky after JT, as he has Pollard on a truly terrible Titans offense, a 52-year-old Aaron Jones, and Chris Rodriguez (I'll mail you a nickel if you actually know who that is). But hey, he has Drake Maye, which is cool. And his TEs are elite. I'd guess it's LIKELY that Jared trades a TE for some much-needed RB or WR help.

11 C+

A Little Distraction

Artie  /  0-1 · 70 PF

I'm lukewarm on this team… which probably means it's really good. I'm not a Burrow guy because I like a QB who plays more than 10 games per season, but hey, the gamble might pay off. At RB, Artie has a good anchor with Hampton but then went and drafted the crayon eater — he'll look like a world beater for the 5-9 games he plays, but that man is going to die on a football field before the age of 28. Sad. Corum is a nice depth piece and Najee could be a sneaky pick. The WR corps is decent yet unspectacular — Lamb is one of my guys, but Pickens eats into his ceiling a lot. Everyone's saying this is the year of the Slim Reaper (D. Smith), but I worry Philly doesn't throw the ball enough for him to put up consistent WR1 numbers. All in all, I think this is a decent roster, but nothing about it moves the needle dramatically one way or the other for me.

12 D+

The Long Shot

Tarryn  /  0-1 · 108 PF

This team just doesn't do it for me. Daniels struggled last year — both with injuries and with being good at football. This year his O-line got even worse, but he's still a "premium" QB — I'm not expecting good things. I'm really not sure what's going on at RB here. Love and Tuten are crazy hyped but far from a sure thing. Brooks is finally "healthy" but will definitely be on IR by week 6, and White and Brooks are scrubs — RB is going to be a major issue. The receivers must be stacked then, right? No. JSN is the guy, we know that. But Tate is an exciting rookie with a horrible QB, Wan'Dale Robinson is a short-yardage guy, and Shakir isn't someone who's going to be a reliable WR2. Tarryn will need to hope Brock Bowers comes back soon and strong after getting his meniscus "trimmed"... whatever the fuck that means. I think this squad is in trouble. But hey, I feel like I say that every year and Tarryn somehow manages to prove me wrong. I guess the team name holds true.

12 teams. 1 opinion. Nobody asked, everybody got one.
